text: {"differences":[{"evidence":"Bachelor's degree vs Doctoral degree","dimension":"academic level","description":"This captures how advanced the applicant’s formal computer-science education is.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"5 years at Expedia vs 7 years at Zillow","dimension":"industry tenure","description":"This captures the amount of professional software experience the applicant claims.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"launching 2 of them vs launching 6 of them","dimension":"delivery volume","description":"This captures how many systems or products the applicant says they have shipped.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"shipping language-model-backed capabilities vs no separate AI example","dimension":"AI product experience","description":"This captures direct experience building features that use machine learning or language models.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"ability to perform security assessments vs OSCP certification and CTFs","dimension":"security depth","description":"This captures the explicitness and credibility of security-specific expertise beyond general software work.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"I am drawn to teams whose success shows up as reliability felt across an entire company vs no comparable org-scale mission statement","dimension":"systems mindset","description":"This captures orientation toward building foundational infrastructure that serves a whole organization rather than a single product area.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"open-source project with a genuine user community vs capture-the-flag competitions","dimension":"external impact type","description":"This captures whether the extra signal comes from real-world maintainer impact or from security-hacking practice.","winner":"A"}]}
